title: Carbon dioxide traps heat
summary: Foote showed that carbon dioxide and water vapour absorb heat from sunlight, and suggested more CO2 could warm the planet.
why: The first experimental hint of the greenhouse effect of carbon dioxide.

notes.problem: 'First identified the warming effect' overstates: source says she 'did not examine or detect the absorption ... within the thermal infrared range'; Tyndall first showed the mechanism.

unsung.contribution: Showed in 1856 that CO2 and water vapour absorb heat from sunlight, and suggested more CO2 would warm the Earth.
unsung.recognition: Her work was unknown for almost a century; John Tyndall was long recognised as first.
